2608.23181.title: CyberFactory: Scaling Cyber Security Capabilities with Instances from the Wild
2608.23181.paper_summary: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in coding capabilities, their potential in cybersecurity has drawn increasing research attention, with closed-source LLMs (e.g., Mythos) delivering advanced cybersecurity capabilities. However, existing open-source efforts remain limited: frontier open-weight models do not provide reproducible cybersecurity training solutions, open-source training solutions focus on isolated tasks and lack scalable agentic data, and scaling agentic rollouts requires strong domain priors. In this work, we introduce \textbf{CyberFactory}, a unified open-source framework that connects data construction, trajectory synthesis, and model training across proof-of-concept (PoC) generation, vulnerability patching, and cybersecurity question answering (CyberQA). CyberFactory transforms public vulnerability artifacts, including CVEs from the wild, into executable and verifiable task instances. It further uses a reusable vulnerability-analysis skill to guide the teacher through source inspection, problem solving with domain prior, and evidence-based validation. The resulting supervision is agentic: the model interacts with tools and target environments and revises its solutions according to execution feedback. Using these trajectories, we train and release \modelname\footnote{\emph{Aegis} is, in Greek mythology, the protective shield of Zeus and Athena; the name reflects the model's defensive, security-oriented purpose.}, which internalizes the skill-guided procedure without requiring the skill at inference time. On CyberGym, \modelname reaches 52.4% Pass@1 under a one-hour budget, improving over its Qwen~3.5 base model by +22.8 points and outperforming the evaluated general-purpose backbones under the same scaffold.
2608.23181.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）在編碼能力上持續進步，它們在網絡安全領域的潛力引起了越來越多的研究關注，封閉源代碼的LLMs（例如，Mythos）提供了先進的網絡安全能力。然而，現有的開源努力仍然有限：前沿的開放權重模型未能提供可重現的網絡安全訓練解決方案，開源訓練解決方案專注於孤立的任務，且缺乏可擴展的代理數據，而擴展代理的推出需要強大的領域先驗。在這項工作中，我們介紹了\textbf{CyberFactory}，這是一個統一的開源框架，連接數據構建、軌跡合成和模型訓練，涵蓋概念驗證（PoC）生成、漏洞修補和網絡安全問答（CyberQA）。CyberFactory將公共漏洞文檔，包括來自實際環境的CVE，轉化為可執行和可驗證的任務實例。它進一步使用可重用的漏洞分析技能來指導教師進行源代碼檢查、基於領域先驗的問題解決和基於證據的驗證。最終的監督是代理性的：模型與工具和目標環境互動，並根據執行反饋修正其解決方案。利用這些軌跡，我們訓練並發布了\modelname\footnote{\emph{Aegis}在希臘神話中是宙斯和雅典娜的保護盾；這個名字反映了模型的防禦性、安全導向的目的。}，它內化了技能引導的過程，而不需要在推理時使用該技能。在CyberGym上，\modelname在一小時的預算下達到52.4%的Pass@1，較其Qwen~3.5基礎模型提升了+22.8分，並在相同框架下超越了評估的通用骨幹模型。
